meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪和管理长期目标进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在对话中持续跟踪多个长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Track and manage long-running goals persistently
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to persistently track and manage long-running goals in conversation.

howto.what: Claude 会多出一套目标跟踪工具:能创建目标、查看当前目标状态,并在确认没有剩余工作时把目标标记为完成(update_goal 只接受 complete)。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求设置、继续、审计等长期目标操作,或已存在进行中的目标时触发。

say.text: 建一个长期目标:完成 pi-goal 扩展,预算 50000
say.note: 会调用 create_goal 创建目标

say.text: 看看现在的目标进展如何
say.note: 调用 get_goal 读取目标

say.text: 把当前目标标记为完成
say.note: 只有所有必需工作做完才会被置为完成

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains goal-tracking tools: it can create a goal, inspect the current goal, and mark it complete only after confirming no required work remains (update_goal only accepts "complete").
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, or audit a long-running goal, or when an active goal already exists.

say_en.text: Create a long-term goal: ship pi-goal extension, budget 50000
say_en.note: Calls create_goal to establish the goal.

say_en.text: Show me the current goal status.
say_en.note: Calls get_goal to read the goal.

say_en.text: Mark the current goal as complete.
say_en.note: Only allowed when no required work remains.
